skill.summary: Browser-automated file download with enhanced features. Auto-detects platform (Windows/macOS/Linux, 64/32-bit, ARM/Intel), handles multi-step navigation (homepage to platform-specific pages), captures auto-downloads triggered on page load, and falls back to button clicking when needed. Ideal for complex download flows where curl/wget fail due to client-side rendering, automatic downloads, or multi-page navigation. Features page scrolling for lazy content, extended wait times, and Golang support.
